channel.title: Computational Intelligence, Physics & Mathematics Group News

item.title: Time-dependent flux backgrounds published in JHEP
item.description: Ahmed Rakin Kamal and Ratul Mahanta's work on time-dependent type-IIB flux backgrounds appeared in JHEP in June 2026.

item.title: Fibre-inflation work published in JCAP
item.description: The collaboration on moduli redefinitions and fibre inflation was published in JCAP in June 2026.

item.title: String-Pheno seminar on time-dependent type-IIB backgrounds
item.description: Ahmed Rakin Kamal presented time-dependent flux backgrounds in type IIB supergravity at the String-Pheno Seminars on 10 February 2026.

item.title: Higher-derivative four-point check published in JHEP
item.description: The D=11 versus D=10 one-loop four-point analysis appeared in JHEP in February 2026.

item.title: New work in noncommutative mathematical physics
item.description: Syed Hasibul Hassan Chowdhury's 2026 Journal of Geometry and Physics article links Bopp shifts, toroidal structures and K-theoretic gap labels in noncommutative quantum mechanics.

item.title: Group members contribute to PWF Bangladesh school on gravitation and cosmology
item.description: Ahmed Rakin Kamal, Sayeda Tashnuba Jahan and Mishaal Hai were listed among the programme coordinators for the 2025 Physics Without Frontiers Bangladesh School on General Relativity and Cosmology.
